'''Aarrom''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who owned the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] known as the [[Shorn Stabilizer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Aarrom used his even-temper to maintain the peace in the cantina, which came to be known as the best neutral drinking-hole in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]], a place where opposing factions could safely meet. The Ithorian, who struck an imposing figure himself, kept four state-of-the-art [[Security droid/Legends|security droids]] on site in case any patrons who didn't respect the establishment's neutrality.<ref name="SoF" /> Aarrom was a common name amongst the Ithorian [[Species/Legends|species]] and meant waves, specifically breaking waves.<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Aarrom was first mentioned in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2014]] for [[Fantasy Flight Games]] ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying system.<ref name="SoF" />
